numerical_contract: Actual-column amax, pow2 scales, E4M3 RN, FP32 GEMM accumulation, BF16 dW. Preserve FP8 AB/Z cache boundaries. One column conversion per block, reused globally. Fixed224/56 math/control registers.

candidates.subgroup: Uniform participation mask across active warp lanes; width4 shuffles and two xor/max steps preserve each row's four-lane group.
candidates.decode: Packed E4M3-to-FP16 decode plus exact integer exponent adjustment into BF16 for safe normal pow2 ranges; original floating fallback for exceptional values/ranges. Applied to row-col and cached-Z decode.
candidates.swiglu: Parallelize the three independent column-amax planes over192threads instead of64threads processing all three serially.
candidates.dw_order: One shared stable descending-row-count expert order per CTA, filled by the producer warp before dW tasks. Keep each task's original K accumulation order. Fallback for more than256ownedexperts.
candidates.dw_pipeline: Three operand stages. Reuse dead activation-conversion scratch space for the dW arena, preventing an unnecessary shared-memory sum of nonoverlapping lifetimes.
candidates.dw_scale: Load per-column scales before WGMMA issue, keeping them in registers through promotion; measure added spill against potential latency hiding.
candidates.pull3: Use the otherwise idle third control warp for row pulls, keeping224/56register partition.
candidates.pull_direct: Warp-vector global loads/stores of already-quantized source packets, avoiding per-row shared-buffer TMA roundtrip. Keep row publication fences.
candidates.swi_packed: Use three hardware BF16x2 rounding operations instead of six scalar bit-rounding sequences in each FP8 SwiGLU pair; preserve nonfinite scalar behavior via fallback and preserve dprob FMA order.
candidates.dw_joint: Stable descending-row-count order with both dW1/dW2 tile sets together for each expert, rather than restarting the expert order in separate dW2 then dW1 queue halves.
candidates.fwd_pack: Round FC1 accumulators to the existing BF16 boundary once, pack pairs, and compute packed integer amax before the unchanged AB quantization/SwiGLU path. Intended to shorten the FP32 live range.

procedure: Build immutable independent source snapshots; finish all compilation before GPU measurements. Validate candidates with full EP8 parity/protocol checks on all3modeldimensions. Screen identical workloads including bracketed FP8 baseline and BF16; then combine and repeat long unprofiled tests for winners. Do not sum FWD/BWD host API timers as GPU kernel timings.

profile_to_experiments.action: No barrier removal or routing changes: prior profile attributes waits to routed-load imbalance; source quantization and padding lower priority. These are not claimed fixed.
